<mark class="pn"><ruby>俄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">É</rt></ruby><ruby>斐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fěi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>金<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>贵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuì</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>红<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>玛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>瑙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>蓝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lán</rt></ruby><ruby>宝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>足<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>较<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liànɡ</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>朋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>友<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">you</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>仍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby><ruby>老<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎo</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>。

“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>聪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>晓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>尺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>度<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dù</rt></ruby>？<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>准<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>绳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>置<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>？<ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>角<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>晨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>星<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>唱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chànɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby>。

“<ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>冲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>胎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tāi</rt></ruby><ruby>胞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bāo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>关<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>闭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>云<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yún</rt></ruby><ruby>彩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>衣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>幽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yōu</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>包<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bāo</rt></ruby><ruby>裹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>布<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>界<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>限<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>闩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuān</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>狂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>傲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>浪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>止<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>。’

“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>晨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>清<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>晨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>位<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>普<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>极<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>驱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qū</rt></ruby><ruby>逐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhú</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>改<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>变<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>泥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ní</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>印<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yìn</rt></ruby><ruby>印<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yìn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>现<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>衣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>亮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Liànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>横<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>膀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>臂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>折<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhé</rt></ruby><ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby>。

“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>源<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>深<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>渊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuān</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>隐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>密<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mì</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>亡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>显<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>露<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>荫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>广<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>透<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tòu</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>！

“<ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Guānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby>？<ruby>黑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hēi</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>位<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>境<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>室<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？
